applies_why: The judge text treats Luke 2:48-49 as an answered verse rather than as an unanswered witness for a broken link.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it: read either as barring any count once answered, or as leaving its status merely noted; the text notes answered and makes no broken-link count.
why: The judge does not count the answered Luke 2:48-49 verse as an unanswered witness, which is what K-G4 requires.
